confirmedFindings.evidence: Both schema copies allow eventCategory audit|diagnostic and deliveryClass durable|best_effort, while local SMPP emits dotted event categories and audit|operational delivery classes.
validateEnvelope requires deliveryClass=durable and eventCategory=audit; the source-derived vector is rejected.
The allowlist contains resource.state but SMPP emits provider.resource.state; current Business Event record types are absent.
Normalizer and landing mapper ignore canonical top-level traceId/spanId and read only nested attributes.
Documentation requires Runtime->Collector and Collector->Processor mTLS, but Compose exposes plaintext OTLP and configures a plaintext Processor exporter.
generate-config.ts emits providerId=* and instanceId=* and the resolver accepts wildcards.
The user-provided Runtime /metrics endpoint is reachable, but Collector has no Prometheus receiver or runtime metrics pipeline.
Processor does not require/cross-check sdar.schema.name and sdar.schema.version, and Collector marks any log with sdar.record.id as ProviderOps.
Canonical payload omits providerEventId/Sequence, eventType, execution mode/simulation, revisions, hashes, and top-level trace/span; landing omits several first-class fields.
Invalid/hash/sensitive events are counted but no safe rejected summary is persisted even though a ClickHouse table exists.
Query API lacks a bounded activity search across provider/resource/task/operation/runtime/deployment/record/trace/time dimensions.
status.sh calls /health/live on Query API while the implementation exposes /health; the deployment test references a missing docs path; no image revision labels or qualification lifecycle exist.
